Understanding the Root Cause: Why Do We Lose Hair?

Before looking at a solution, it helps to understand the problem. For many individuals experiencing thinning hair, the culprit is a hormonal byproduct known as DHT (dihydrotestosterone). When testosterone is converted by the enzyme 5-alpha-reductase into DHT, it binds to hair follicles, causing them to shrink over time. This triggers what experts call the Cellular Blockage Cycle, cutting off vital nutrients, shortening the hair growth phase, and ultimately leading to increased shedding and thinning.

Traditional hair products often only coat the surface strands, failing to address the cellular stagnation happening underneath the scalp. To truly encourage healthy regrowth, you need a targeted formula capable of breaking this blockage cycle, clearing out buildup, and recharging dormant follicles.
